$comment: Agent role -> pinned Magic: The Gathering card whose art fronts the agent card. Every pin MUST come from templates/approved-mtg-cards.json (the operator's favorited cards from the avatar-set-gallery vote exports) — fetch_mtg_art.py enforces this and substitutes from the pool otherwise. Fetched from Scryfall (fuzzy named lookup). RIGHTS: card art is (c) Wizards of the Coast; WotC Fan Content Policy is NON-COMMERCIAL — internal demos only until replaced with licensed/generated art at Gate 3. Artist attribution is mandatory wherever the art renders.
